critical_code_review_comments: evalExpression percentage regex is ordered correctly: ([+\-]) before ([*/]) so '1000-30%' is parsed as base±delta% (=700) and '1000*30%' as base*pct (=300). The strict regex /^[\d+\-*/().,]+$/ on evalCore prevents injection. Sandboxed Function() is safe.
lineResult gate /[+\-*/xX×÷%]/ now includes %, so a single '30%' line shows '= 0,3'. Confirmed in UI.

AnalyticsSection.KpiTile: value div uses 'text-lg sm:text-2xl whitespace-nowrap' — verified at 390px viewport with all 3 KPIs single-lining (22.5px height). euroShort uses Math.round + '\u00A0€' (NBSP) so the euro never wraps below the number.
Backend ClientCreate now has Optional default '' for address & phone; handleCreate only blocks empty name. Verified UI accepts name-only submission.

Timeline: fmtDate returns French toLocaleDateString('fr-FR', {day:'2-digit', month:'short'}) — produces '28 avr.' format as required. Badges conditionally render only when timestamp exists (e.sent_at/opened_at/signed_at/lost_at).

Minor (non-blocking): Radix DialogContent emits an a11y warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' on every dialog open (crm-create-dialog, edit-client-dialog). Adding <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby='{undefined}' would silence it without functional impact.
